title: The Portfolio Band Read across a Client's Micro Market Estate
content:
The settlement a client pays on each micro market in the Unattended Micro Market Program is discounted by a portfolio band that reads the client's whole market estate rather than the single site being invoiced.

## How the band is found

The band is found by counting the client's micro market agreements that stand active or suspended on the day the settlement invoice is raised, then taking the highest ladder step whose agreement count does not exceed that number. The ladder is the one printed against the market format of the agreement being invoiced, and the count of active and suspended agreements is the measure the band is read from.

Agreements still proposed or installing and agreements already closed are outside the count.

## Scope of the discount

The clause reading "The discount is applied to the management fee and the equipment lease only; product cost, subsidy true-up, shrink adjustments and one-off charges carry no portfolio discount." is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which a micro market is invoiced the standing charge it carries while it is closed off.

## Where the estate changes mid-period

Where the estate changes part way through a settlement period, the count taken on the invoice day governs the whole of that invoice, and invoices already raised are not reopened.

## A worked reading

A client holds seven micro market agreements, of which five stand active, one stands suspended and one is still installing on the day one of its Standard Micro Market settlements is raised. Six agreements stand active or suspended, so the band taken is the highest step of the Standard Micro Market ladder whose agreement count does not exceed six. Were one of those six to close a week later, the invoice already raised would not be reopened.

superseded_clauses: The discount is applied to the management fee and the equipment lease only; product cost, subsidy true-up, shrink adjustments and one-off charges carry no portfolio discount.
